CrossMux 1.6.2 for Waveshare ESP32-S3 ePaper 3.97 fixes OTA updates broken in 1.6.1 by correcting the manifest board-tag check.

## Devices and installation

- Devices running 1.6.1 cannot OTA to this release; install 1.6.2 once over USB, then stable OTA works again.
- After USB flash, use Settings OTA or wait for the stable channel manifest on `github.com/dezzw/crossmux` releases.
- The Firmware Release workflow still publishes stable builds on semver tag pushes only.

## Reading and reliability

- Fix OTA board-tag matching: compare the manifest `boardTag` length-aware against `boardName()` instead of `strcmp` on a pointer into the longer `CROSSPOINT-BOARD-V1` tag string.
- 1.6.1 rejected every update manifest with a boardTag mismatch; 1.6.2 accepts valid Waveshare manifests again.

## Firmware assets

- Stable builds ship as `waveshare-epaper-397-firmware.bin` with matching bootloader, partitions, boot_app0, manifests, and SHA-256 checksum files on GitHub Releases.
- Rolling tag `stable` carries the signed `waveshare-epaper-397-global-manifest.json` for OTA after you are on 1.6.2.
- Normal stable OTA updates preserve books and reading data on the SD card.

## 中文摘要

- 修复 OTA 板型校验：`strcmp` 误用导致 1.6.1 拒绝所有更新清单；本版改为按长度比较 manifest 的 `boardTag`。
- 正在使用 1.6.1 的设备无法 OTA 到本版，需先 USB 刷入 1.6.2，之后可恢复正常 OTA。
- 稳定版固件与签名清单仍从 `github.com/dezzw/crossmux` 发布页获取。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dezzw/crossmux/compare/1.6.1...1.6.2
